The day has come for the Yasuda Kinen,
where
Марузенски is set to compete
against Grass
Wonder.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excited about competing against the
promising
younger student, Марузенски
goes into the race
with great enthusiasm.
